categories.label: Wife hypnotized (by anyone — husband, therapist, villain, vampire, stranger)
Pregnancy + mind control — variants and leads

entries.title: Dracula
entries.creator: Bram Stoker
entries.gist: Count Dracula forces Mina Harker into a blood bond that leaves her telepathically linked to him; Van Helsing then hypnotizes her before dawn so she can report Dracula's movements.

entries.title: Trilby
entries.creator: George du Maurier
entries.gist: The musician and hypnotist Svengali puts the tone-deaf artist's model Trilby O'Ferrall under hypnosis and makes her a celebrated singer, 'La Svengali'; she cannot sing once his control ends.
entries.where: Later chapters (her career as 'La Svengali' and collapse after his death)
entries.wife: no (passed off as Svengali's partner; never legally married in the sources)

entries.title: The Avengers #200 (Ms. Marvel / Marcus)
entries.creator: Jim Shooter, David Michelinie, Bob Layton, George Pérez; Marvel
entries.gist: Marcus takes Carol Danvers (Ms. Marvel) to another dimension, rapes and impregnates her; commentators note the story implies he brainwashed her into 'loving' him, and she leaves with him.
entries.pregnant_end: yes — gives birth on Earth to a child who ages into Marcus
entries.note: Brainwashing is implied (critics' reading), so this is a loose fit.

entries.title: Alias (Jessica Jones vs. the Purple Man)
entries.creator: Brian Michael Bendis, Michael Gaydos
entries.gist: Zebediah Killgrave, the Purple Man, uses mind control to put Jessica Jones under his command for months, psychologically torturing her and forcing her into his schemes; she later breaks his control.
entries.pregnant_end: yes — pregnant by Luke Cage at the end of Alias #28
entries.kids_together: yes (with Luke Cage, after the control; daughter Danielle later)

entries.title: Fantastic Four: Malice, Mistress of Hate
entries.creator: John Byrne
entries.gist: Psycho-Man manipulates a depressed Susan Storm into becoming Malice, Mistress of Hate, and she attacks her own family until Reed breaks the control.
entries.kids_before: yes — Franklin; a second pregnancy was stillborn just before (FF #267)

entries.title: The Dark Phoenix Saga
entries.creator: Chris Claremont, John Byrne
entries.gist: Mastermind (Jason Wyngarde), using Emma Frost's mind-tap device, projects illusions into Jean Grey's mind so she believes she is Lady Grey, the Hellfire Club's Black Queen and his lover.

entries.title: Rosemary's Baby
entries.creator: Ira Levin
entries.gist: Rosemary Woodhouse is drugged with a tainted dessert and, in a trance-like dream state during a coven ritual, is raped and impregnated.
entries.pregnant_end: yes — gives birth to the child
entries.kids_together: yes (the child; father is not her husband)
entries.note: Drugging and a ritual, not formal hypnosis — loose fit.

entries.title: Tauros ~Hypnotism Wife NTR~
entries.creator: Yokoyama Naoki
entries.gist: Manager Harada hypnotizes the company president's wife into treating him as her second husband.

entries.title: Joseph Balsamo (Memoirs of a Physician)
entries.creator: Alexandre Dumas (with Auguste Maquet)
entries.gist: Balsamo (Cagliostro) keeps his reluctant young wife Lorenza Feliciani locked away and in magnetic trances, using her clairvoyance in trance to learn the future and his victims' secrets; she loves him only while entranced and rebels when lucid.
entries.note: The same novel has Gilbert rape Andrée de Taverney during her magnetic sleep and then take the child she bears. Her age isn't stated in the sources, so she isn't listed.

entries.title: The House of the Seven Gables
entries.original_title: The House of the Seven Gables
entries.creator: Nathaniel Hawthorne
entries.gist: In Holgrave's story-within-the-story, Matthew Maule hypnotizes the haughty Alice Pyncheon, supposedly to find documents, and leaves her permanently under his command; he forces her into public humiliations, and she dies of pneumonia after being made to go out in the cold in an evening dress.

sources.label: Wikipedia: The House of the Seven Gables

entries.adult_basis: adult daughter of a colonial gentleman, of marriageable age (inferred, not stated)

entries.title: False Memory
entries.creator: Dean Koontz
entries.gist: Psychiatrist Dr. Mark Ahriman drugs and programs his patients. Martie Rhodes, a wife, is conditioned into crippling phobias and obedience, and her agoraphobic friend Susan Jagger is repeatedly raped under hypnotic control.

entries.title: Action Comics #593 (Big Barda and Sleez)
entries.creator: John Byrne
entries.gist: The New God Sleez brainwashes Superman and Big Barda, who is Mister Miracle's wife, sexually assaults Barda on film, and tries to make them perform in a pornographic film.

entries.creator: David Eddings
entries.gist: The dark god Torak, whose prophecy names Polgara as his bride, tries to bend her mind to his will during the final confrontation; her refusal breaks his morale and leads to his defeat.
entries.note: An attempt she resists; loose fit.
